Wavering between groups, belonging fully to neither
Believers warned against taking unbelievers as protectors in place of believers
Hypocrites assigned the lowest depth of the Fire
Exception for repentance, reform, holding fast to God and sincere religion

Condemnation of separating belief in God from belief in some messengers
